title: Local MoR — Margin of Reality. Everything That IS and IS Mine.
thesis: MoR is not 'how much reality do I have.' MoR is the MARGIN — the boundary where MY reality meets NOT-mine. The desktop IS my desk. The phone IS my pocket. The LAN IS my house. The VPN IS my tunnel. The relay IS my voice. The PWA IS my bag of holding. Everything inside the margin = mine. Everything outside = the world. The Klein fold IS the margin.

near.what: Things I can TOUCH right now. Within arm's reach.
near.klein_fold: The desk IS the near field. The screen IS the window. The keyboard IS the input face.

local.what: Things on my LAN. Same house. Same WiFi. Same switch.
local.klein_fold: The house IS the local field. The LAN IS the cytoplasm. Every device is an organelle.

behind.what: Things I can walk to. House 2. Need to power on.
behind.klein_fold: House 2 IS the deep storage. Dormant but not dead. Walking there IS the modality.

tunnel.what: Things accessible via WireGuard. The relay. The internet.
tunnel.klein_fold: The tunnel IS the axon. It reaches beyond the house to the world. The relay IS the synapse.

pocket.what: The bag of holding. grapheneGate (Pixel 8a). Always with me.
apps: PWA (hud.primals.eco installed as app — the SAME membrane)
pocket.klein_fold: The phone IS the bag of holding. Everything the desk has, compressed. Same PWA, same service worker, same data, same membrane. But ALSO: 37 sensors the desk doesn't have. GPS. Camera. Gyroscope. Barometer. The phone is not LESS than the desk. It's DIFFERENT folds of the same surface.
pocket.the_card: The PWA on the phone IS 'the mobile version.' It's a card on the home screen. Opens full-screen. No browser chrome. Push notifications. Offline via service worker. It IS the desk, folded into a pocket.

desk.what: The literal desk. northGate sits on it. Monitor, keyboard, mouse, headset. The NEAR field.
desk.metaphor: The desk is the workbench. The artisan's table. Everything here is within arm's reach. This is where MAKING happens.

home.what: The whole house. All devices on the LAN. The LOCAL field.
home.metaphor: The house is the body. Each room is an organ. The kitchen is the stomach (where food becomes energy). The desk is the brain (where thinking happens). The living room is the eye (Steam Frame — the observation surface). The printer is the heart (bits?ink?paper, always beating).

pocket.what: grapheneGate. In the pocket. ALWAYS with me.
pocket.metaphor: The bag of holding from D&D. Bigger on the inside. Contains the ENTIRE membrane, all feeds, all stories, all data — but folded down to a 6.1-inch screen. Plus 37 sensors the desk doesn't have.

desk_and_home.the_fold: Desk (near) ? Home (local) ? Pocket (portable). But ALSO: Pocket ? Home ? Desk. The phone is IN the house which is ON the desk. But the desk is ON the phone (PWA) which is IN the pocket which is OUTSIDE the house. Klein topology. No inside, no outside. Just folds.
